name: The Foretold Soldier
oracle_text:
This creature must be blocked if able.
This creature can't be blocked by more than one creature.
Whenever this creature deals damage, exile it face down. It becomes foretold.
Foretell {1}{G} (During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever this creature deals damage, exile it face down. It becomes foretold.
This creature must be blocked if able.

needs.what: an op that exiles a permanent (here the source itself) face down from the battlefield and marks it foretold for its owner, so the engine's foretold-card casting path (suspend.foretold_cards / casting with foretold=True) later offers it for its foretell cost on a later turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `exile` op has no face_down or foretold option, and the card-level `foretell` key only covers the hand-paid {2} special action; nothing in `ops` puts a card into the foretold exile state as an effect

needs.what: a static on the creature itself requiring the defending player to block it with at least one creature if able ("must be blocked if able"), combined with the existing max_blockers 1
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `attacks_if_able` is the attacker-side requirement; the `must_block` / `must_block_any` ops are one-shot effects on blockers, not a standing requirement imposed by the attacker on the defending player's blocks
